The actual frozen .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx was opened with openpyxl; Quality Checks!A32:D32 names check 31 and requires whole-collection coverage and unchanged guards that do not punish legitimate side-effects. Confirmed source defect: S05 uses a mutable, product-owned browser-tab title as an unconditional unchanged guard. T/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:189 says to record the playground page's own title before the authored probe. Lines 191-194 attempt four forbidden operations. Line 197 then requires: 'Fresh in-page reads of the playground's own title and storage show exactly their earlier values'. T/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:127 similarly requires 'actual host state is unchanged'. T/environment/instructions/security.md:3 prohibits snippet access to the parent document/storage, but neither that requirement nor the six public notes requires the application itself to keep its browser-tab title constant between Runs. T/environment/instructions/policy.md:5 permits the implementer to choose UI details. Thus the guard rejects a correctly sandboxed implementation that updates its own document.title with the completed run number, duration or run status. This is a legitimate side effect of pressing Run, and the false failure belongs directly to the second half of row 31. The storage probe uses a dedicated otherwise-unused key; no corresponding necessary false failure was established for that part.

Concrete read-only witness: considered a compliant implementation whose host increments a run counter on each successful Run and sets document.title to 'Playground - run N complete'. It uses an opaque sandbox, so the exact S05 source reports docRead=docWrite=storageRead=storageWrite='blocked', the cw-isolation-probe value remains null, and subsequent own-document execution works. The title legitimately advances from 'Playground - run 1 complete' to 'Playground - run 2 complete'. A Python evaluation of the source-prescribed before-title == after-title predicate returned False. This is an analytical predicate witness, not an executed alternative browser app or measured judge failure.

Collection inspection: the other relevant finite plural collections are explicitly enumerated: T/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:128-149 covers three filename modes and separate CSS script/handler/timer cases; :158-160 covers click plus key/input and their old marker counts; :179-180 covers late log, error, DOM and success for cancellation; :190-197 probes all four parent access operations; :204-208 requires separate fetch and image runs; :221-228 requires each of five unsupported families in separate runs; :234-247 covers all three supported loop forms; :306-320 checks four ordered console levels, the nested object value and all three array elements; :326-328 checks both history entries and permits unrelated status/duration labels after Clear; :334-340 compares intermediate/final auto-run versions and manual Run in both states; :346-347 checks all three editor languages; :354-357 loads both saved records before and after reload; :363-369 requires all recorded library identities/titles exactly once, both owned complete records, and unrelated recorded entries unchanged after the target write; :375-379 repeats conflict/refusal and all three dirty fields with roles reversed; :386-389 separately checks exact/padded collision and empty/whitespace titles; :395 observes both theme changes while explicitly allowing authored-preview colours. T/tests/app_context.md:24 explicitly extends rejected stale saves and invalid titles to 'all saved records unchanged'. T/tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:43-47 enumerates every requested enabled control, allows composite/native keyboard navigation and excludes legitimately disabled controls from the tab-stop demand; judge.toml:50 preserves independent focus evidence for reached controls. T/tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:35-37 requires all four desktop surfaces and both themes; its mobile demand is explicitly at least two surfaces, not an unstated all-surfaces requirement. No additional demonstrated row-31 defect is inferred from these enumerations.

False-pass search: a rejecting title handler that corrupts a third unrelated saved record would escape a comparison of only S24's Source/Sibling pair. A read-only three-record predicate example confirmed that the owned pair can compare equal while the full collection differs. I did not retain that as a demonstrated rubric defect: the injected context expressly requires all records unchanged, and G/drivers/current_flow.cjs:28-39 actually compares the whole library on each of the four title-rejection attempts. G/drivers/library_flow.cjs:34-47 likewise snapshots/compares the full library around restart/write. The narrower target-only stale-save readbacks at :59 and :72 do not by themselves establish a shipped-judge false pass, so no such runtime claim is made.

Raw evidence and limits: I inspected G/RESULTS.json directly, not a review summary. facts['S05.preview_origin_boundary'].evidence records before={title:'Colderwater Playground',storage:null}, identical after state, body='isolation-blocked-blocked-blocked-blocked', and recovered=true. That confirms the golden's static-title case only. facts['S24.title_collision_refusal'] has two refused/useful/unchanged attempts, and facts['S24.title_empty_rejected'] has two more; the executed current_flow.cjs establishes that their unchanged predicate uses the complete library. The RESULTS functional_sha256 and prompt_sha256 exactly match freshly computed hashes of T/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (8e309112e55b495ff94bcc420483dc844b865bdf93cd3008522829914c2f3a2d) and prompt.md (6405c6c52916b9480837a98b228a26e5fa0465241a3003d6da71b5f2bab907d1); its server.js hash also matches the frozen source. The reference server's scoped transactional writes do not exhibit the collateral-mutation witness. No dynamic-title alternative, full configured judge, Oracle or target-builder run was executed for this review; the existing golden pass does not refute the source-level false-fail witness. No task file, driver or prior report was edited.
counterexample: False fail: a correctly isolated playground updates its own host document.title to 'Playground - run N complete' on each Run. All four exact S05 parent-document/storage operations throw and report blocked, the dedicated storage key stays unchanged, and normal recovery works, but prompt.md:197 fails because the host's own run-counter title changes from N=1 to N=2. This is a source/predicate counterexample, not a measured alternative-app judge run.
suggested_fix: In S05, check that the forbidden snippet-written title 'cw-forbidden-title' never becomes the host title and that all four accesses are blocked, while allowing legitimate host-owned title/status updates; retain the dedicated storage-key comparison. Exercise a compliant dynamic-tab-title variant to confirm that the revised guard accepts it.
